texts.preamble: Nunna Venkata Suryanarayana Murthy, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh , on 6 May, 2021 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.V.S.S.Somayajulu Crl.P.No.2819 of 2021 Order :
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner points out that Tobacco products are not covered as food items and that number of judges of this Court have passed orders holding that Tobacco products cannot be classified as food and cases cannot be registered under the IPC and the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (COTPA ACT). He relies upon the order passed in Crl.P.No.2408 of 2020, in which, the Hon'ble the Chief Justice while sitting as a single judge considered the matter and [LEAKAGE_MASK] an FIR registered under 272, 273, 328 IPC and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner points out that Tobacco products are not covered as food items and that number of judges of this Court have passed orders holding that Tobacco products cannot be classified as food and cases cannot be registered under the IPC and the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (COTPA ACT). He relies upon the order passed in Crl.P.No.2408 of 2020, in which, the Hon'ble the Chief Justice while sitting as a single judge considered the matter and [LEAKAGE_MASK] an FIR registered under 272, 273, 328 IPC and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
